settings.heading: Because Family
settings.subtext:
Many say pets are family. At Yours Waggly, we wanted to go beyond saying it — so we're bringing pet insurance into your shopping journey, the same care we plan for our loved ones.

Love beyond the bowl. Protection beyond the everyday.

settings.heading: What is pet insurance?
settings.intro: A health cover for your dog or cat. You pay a yearly premium, and when your pet falls ill or gets hurt, the insurer pays back eligible vet bills — up to the cover amount you chose.

settings.title: Visit your vet
settings.description: Get your pet treated and pay the bill. Inform the insurer within 24 hours for emergencies.

settings.title: Collect papers
settings.description: Bills, prescriptions, test reports, vaccination record and photos of your pet.

settings.title: Submit the claim
settings.description: Upload on the insurer's app or website, or send by email with the claim form.

settings.title: Get reimbursed
settings.description: Money reaches your bank account, usually within 7–15 working days.

settings.heading: Four simple steps
settings.body:
Go to any licensed vet you trust — most claims can now be filed from your phone.

Good to know: illness cover usually starts after a 15–30 day waiting period. Accidents are covered from day one.

settings.title: Surgery
settings.text: Operations after an accident or illness, including costs a week before and two weeks after.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='26' height='26' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='9'/><path d='M12 7v10M7 12h10'/></svg>

settings.title: Hospitalisation
settings.text: In-patient stays of 24 hours or more, including ICU care.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='26' height='26' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M3 20V7M3 14h18v6M21 14v-3a3 3 0 0 0-3-3h-7v6'/><circle cx='7' cy='11' r='1.6'/></svg>

settings.title: Vet visits (OPD)
settings.text: Consultations, diagnostics and medicines for listed illnesses — often ₹10,000–₹30,000.

settings.title: Long-term care
settings.text: A lump sum when your pet is diagnosed with chronic conditions like diabetes or epilepsy.

settings.title: Serious illness
settings.text: A lump sum for cancer, kidney failure, heart disease, distemper and similar diagnoses.

settings.title: Third-party liability
settings.text: If your pet bites someone or damages property — legal and medical costs, often up to lakhs.

settings.text: Pays your pet's value if not found, plus the costs of advertising and a reward.

settings.title: Thoughtful extras
settings.text: Tele-vet calls, home visits, pet-sitting if you're hospitalised, ambulance, trip cancellation.

settings.heading: The protections you can choose
settings.intro: Most Indian plans are built from these building blocks. You pick the ones that matter for your pet.

settings.title: Pre-existing conditions
settings.text: Anything diagnosed or treated before the policy started.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Hereditary & congenital issues
settings.text: Often excluded or covered only as an add-on — e.g. hip dysplasia in large breeds.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Cosmetic & elective procedures
settings.text: Tail docking, ear cropping, grooming, cosmetic dental work.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Routine care
settings.text: Vaccines, deworming and microchipping themselves (some premium plans add wellness cover).
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Breeding & pregnancy
settings.text: Whelping and spaying/neutering, unless due to complications.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Missed vaccinations
settings.text: Illness from a disease your pet should have been vaccinated against.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Neglect or commercial use
settings.text: Injury from cruelty, racing, guarding or fighting.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.title: Alternative treatments
settings.text: Herbal or experimental therapies, unless a specific add-on is bought.
settings.svg_code: <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18'/></svg>

settings.heading: What's usually not covered
settings.intro: Knowing these upfront avoids heartbreak at claim time. Pre-existing conditions are the #1 reason claims are rejected.

settings.heading: The window to join closes early
settings.body:
Most insurers only accept new pets until about 5–8 years of age — and as early as 4 for giant breeds like Great Danes and St. Bernards.

Buying young means lower premiums and fewer exclusions. Small and medium breeds usually enjoy the widest joining window; giant breeds the narrowest.

settings.question: Bajaj General — pick any cover
settings.answer:
• Dogs join 3 months–7 years (giant breeds to 4); cats 3 months–7 years.
  • Choose any mix: surgery (₹10,000–₹3 lakh), hospitalisation, OPD (up to ₹30,000), serious illness, long-term care, death benefit, liability, lost/stolen.
  • Policy terms from a few months to 3 years.
  • 5% off for RFID tagging; up to 50% bonus for claim-free years; multi-pet discounts.
  • Unusual extras: vaccination-failure cover and reward money for finding a lost pet.

settings.question: HDFC ERGO — comprehensive or custom
settings.answer:
• Comprehensive, liability-only, or a custom plan. Covers up to 5 pets per owner.
  • Illness, injury, surgery, diagnostics, OPD and emergency care, funeral costs, and trip cancellation if your pet's emergency cancels a domestic trip.
  • 4 vet-on-call and 2 video consultations per policy. No health check-up needed to buy.
  • Claims settled within 7 working days of the last document.

settings.question: ICICI Lombard — big illness & surgery list
settings.answer:
• Pets join 3 months–7 years (giant dogs to 4).
  • Base plan covers a long list of illnesses incl. tick fever, skin and dental infections, and 40+ surgeries.
  • Add-ons: OPD, dental, physiotherapy & hydrotherapy, pregnancy complications, tele-vet, liability, pet-minding, ambulance, trip cancellation.
  • Every claim carries a 10% deductible (minimum ₹1,000). 30-day waiting period.

settings.question: Generali Central — surgery & hospital focus
settings.answer:
• Dogs join 3 months–10 years (giant breeds up to 7).
  • Base plan: surgery and hospitalisation with ICU, 15-day pre/post costs, ambulance and sum-insured restoration, plus OPD (20% of cover, max ₹10,000).
  • Add-ons: serious illness, vet home visits, lost & stolen, pet-minding, long-term care, liability, funeral costs.
  • Skin treatments and dental complications are excluded.

settings.question: Universal Sompo — the widest menu of add-ons
settings.answer:
• Cover ₹10,000–₹2 lakh with 17 optional covers; 30-day waiting period.
  • Pets join 3 months–7 years (giant breeds to 4); policy terms 1–3 years.
  • Options include tick-borne diseases, pregnancy, dental, recovery therapy, wellness (vaccines, grooming, daycare), health check-ups and GPS-tag cover.
  • Joint and orthopaedic conditions, cataract and behavioural issues have longer waiting periods.

settings.question: Digit Insurance — app-first
settings.answer:
• Among the first private insurers to offer pet cover in India; promotes simple, app-based claims.
  • Plan details are shared through a quote on the Digit app.

settings.question: Public-sector insurers — basic dog cover
settings.answer:
• New India, Oriental, United India & National mainly cover death of the dog due to accident or illness, rather than vet bills.
  • New India Assurance: dogs 8 weeks–8 years, cover ₹25,000, vet fitness certificate needed. Theft and liability available as extensions.
  • Usually bought at a branch rather than online.

settings.heading: Protection for every budget
settings.subtext: Premiums depend on your pet's breed, age, size and city, and on the covers you choose. Cats and Indie dogs usually cost less to insure than flat-faced or large purebreds.
settings.example_heading: A 2-year-old Labrador, ₹1 lakh cover, every add-on
settings.example_intro: Surgery, hospitalisation and vet visits form the base. Each extra protection adds to the premium — you can drop the ones you don't need.

settings.title: Start while they're young
settings.text: Joining windows close at 5–8 years, and earlier illnesses are never covered.

settings.title: Know your breed's risks
settings.text: Labradors, German Shepherds, Pugs and Persians have known joint, eye or breathing issues — check how they're treated.

settings.title: Read the illness list
settings.text: Check that tick fever, parvo and skin problems are included if they matter to you.

settings.text: A 10–30% share lowers the premium but reduces every payout.

settings.title: Keep vaccinations up to date
settings.text: Missed vaccines are a common reason for claim rejection.

settings.text: Makes identification easy and can earn a discount.

settings.title: Keep some cash ready
settings.text: You pay the vet first and get reimbursed later.

settings.heading: Your pet insurance checklist
settings.intro: A few minutes now saves a lot of stress later.

settings.heading: Talk to your vet first
settings.body: Your vet knows your pet's breed, history and the conditions common in your area. A short conversation helps you choose the covers that truly matter — and makes the claim paperwork smoother when you need it.

settings.left_text: Because they'd do anything for you — and you'd do anything for them.

settings.body:
This page is for general information to help pet parents understand pet insurance. Yours Waggly is not an insurer and this is not insurance advice. Features, limits and prices are indicative, based on insurers' published information as of October 2026, and vary by plan, pet and city. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation — please read the sales brochure and policy wording carefully before buying.

Sources: insurer product pages and brochures of Bajaj General, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Generali Central, Universal Sompo, Digit and New India Assurance.
